concern_summary: This concern encompasses all functionalities related to the management and rendering of the Left Hand Navigation (LHN), including data processing for option rows, the display and interaction of navigation items, visibility toggling, routing adjustments, organization of report groups, and integration of user-specific data.
This concern focuses on the localization aspects of devices, specifically retrieving the preferred language settings for the device.

This concern encompasses settings related to the user interface, including the header display options and navigation to the settings page, ensuring user preferences are easily accessible and configurable.
This concern relates to financial metrics and management settings for Expensify cards, including balance retrieval, payment information, and card visibility controls.
This concern covers workspace and policy tag settings, including creating, managing, and utilizing tags that affect user interactions and expense tracking.

This concern deals with reconciliation and settlement settings associated with bank accounts and Expensify cards, allowing users to manage frequency, selection, and updates for their financial operations.
This concern addresses tax settings and distance rate management, focusing on enabling and validating various settings necessary for travel expense processing.
This concern pertains to user subscription settings, including management of auto-renewal options, preferences display, and related notification configurations.
This concern focuses on managing configuration settings and synchronization with NetSuite, addressing potential issues and ensuring that the settings are aligned with application operations.
This concern is dedicated to handling and updating the individual components of an address based on user input, ensuring that each part of the address reflects the most current information.
